text:
Location: Ton Son Nhut
Inside the van. Weaver was a cool guy and hung out with me a lot. Day shift was probably 4 guys and night shift there was 1 guy. I was on night shift a lot because I was going to the mountain a lot in Nui Ba Den. I felt safer on the mountain that I did at Ton Son Nhut
